acceptance: evolve checkpoint save --all with one dev worktree that has unmerged index entries saves every other worktree and exits 0.
The output names the skipped worktree and the reason, and a signal records the skip.
A test makes a worktree with an unmerged entry through internal/gittest, runs save --all, and asserts the other worktrees are saved and the skip is reported.
fix: checkpoint save --all treats a dev worktree with unmerged index entries as in progress: it skips that worktree, reports it, and saves the others, so one builder mid-merge never stops the wave boundary.
